dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Could we try a different approach to this loop?
dialogue.zh: 我们能为这个循环试试另一种思路吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sure. I'll be the navigator while you explain your idea.
dialogue.zh: 当然。我来做指导者，你来解释你的想法。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I'll take the keyboard as the driver and show a small example.
dialogue.zh: 我作为操作者接过键盘，演示一个小例子。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Great. Then we'll compare the two approaches together.
dialogue.zh: 好。然后我们一起比较这两种思路。

dialogue_storage: PicLex 关键词标签 learning.example/exampleChinese 保存 canonical A,B,A,B 4 话轮对白（A=学习者朗读评分，B=机器朗读不评分，角色标记不朗读）；角色说明仅保留在 cards.roles 元数据；cards.targets 各词 example_en/example_zh 仍为定稿摘录。
communication_goal: 提出另一种实现思路并交换结对角色。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure SOLID BLACK background, bright clean WHITE line art. Minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No colors, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI symbols allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure programmers sit beside each other at ONE desk, facing a simple monitor with only abstract horizontal lines. The left programmer has hands poised above a SEPARATE physical keyboard in the foreground at the desk center; right programmer makes a listening open-palm gesture. The whole rectangular keyboard with simple unlabeled keys is visible, hands above it not covering it. No laptop and no readable code.
